1,6.head.refused: return class ['1', '6.head'] MIXES a placed member with a whole-line one. A placed class declares that the WORD at each placement returns and says nothing about the rest of those lines (REQUIRE_RETURN_AT); a bare line number names no word, so the two are different claims and one class cannot hold both (MISSING M-142). Declare them as two classes.
